recipe.weight_source: Original BF16 checkpoint W, without rescaling or low-rank subtraction
recipe.group_scale: max(amax(group)/6,1e-12)/global, clamp FP32 tiny then E4M3FN RNE
recipe.e2m1: E005 signed nibble convention; ties to numerically smaller value; negative rounded zero uses nibble8
recipe.main: packed NVFP4 F.scaled_mm with E4M3 block scale and FP32 tensor globals
recipe.out: BF16 native main including unchanged original bias; no additional branch
